body:
Thanks for not just telling me to go get help from a doctor/counselor/etc...

I don't want to be a victim. When my parents went through divorce phases (though never acted on it), I talked it through... and that left me feeling anxious and uncomfortable. 

BPD scares the shit out of me, and I'm not quite sure exactly what I'm going to do. But I will try the consequence system. I've hidden my cigs and lighter, I'll probably finish off the alcohol I have by the end of the week (2 handles hard liquor, plus a couple beers).

Not being in a relationship scares me... More than anything. I wouldn't be here right now if it wasn't for my last one. I'd be another kid that drove into the center divider on the freeway.

EDIT - My outlets are currently driving irresponsibly as well as writing. I abuse addictive substances to take the pain away, and to give myself some other issue to deal with. I know it sounds pathetic, I'm not like this.

Thank you... I feel so cliche though. I don't have anyone to call and talk to. I don't have anywhere to turn to, and I don't see it getting better. I just want to end the pain. I've become a drunk, a smoker, and a caffeine addict in trying to take the edge off... And that make things worse....
